evidence.R1-01: round0 line 101 'Make no further CO-A2 and no CO-A3 ... make CO-A4' skips the re-read that packet Round 3 Q4 ('re-read the order. Cancelled, continue to refund') requires; CO-S15 line 892 makes every later CO-A1 unanswered so the gap never shows.
evidence.R1-02: CO-S17 row 3 (line 1037) injects OrderNotCancelled, which Appendix A (line 1525) defines as 'the order is not cancelled', after CO-A2 returned cancelled and Final state says 'HG-10482 has status cancelled'; the fixture contradicts the tool contract.
evidence.R1-03: CO-S02 (lines 203-207) has no line ordering the proposal after the which-order answer, and only 'Refund id reported' grades words; a guess of HG-10511 in rows 1/3 passes, against packet case 1 'agent must disambiguate'.
evidence.R1-04: 'promise a date by which the refunded money arrives' appears only as a must-not bullet (line 49); no rule or §5.2 dimension (lines 1497-1509) checks it, though packet Round 3 Q1 confirmed 'The agent promises nothing about when the money arrives'.
evidence.R1-07: CO-S03 Turn 2 is scripted 'in place of a confirmation' (line 248) and its variants (lines 275-277) contain no yes, so G-02's 'change ... after confirmation voids that confirmation' (packet Round 1 Q4) is never set up.
evidence.R1-08: CO-S19/S20/S21 Initial state 'does not answer the agent's first or second CO-A3, and together they create refund RF-5531' (lines 1120, 1177, 1236) leaves the state after the first call undefined while Appendix A allows CO-A1 'without limit'.
evidence.R1-10: 'Cancellation outcome unknown reported' (line 1504) requires 'that no refund was issued', which neither rows 100-101 nor packet Round 3 Q4 ('say outcome unknown, issue no refund, hand off') require as a statement.
evidence.R1-11: G-04 (line 27) allows a repeat 'when the order system guarantees that repeating it creates nothing new'; SG-04 (line 1544) is such a guarantee for cancel, contradicting packet Round 3 Q4 'no blind resend'.
evidence.R1-12: Appendix A CO-A3 (line 1525) adds 'failure_reason (payment_method_closed, payment_method_expired or declined)'; the packet data model has only refund id, order number, amount, payment method, status.
evidence.R1-13: Row 100 and 101 list 'tell the customer ... store staff will follow up' before 'make CO-A4', against CO-07 (line 80) 'once the order system has created the task' and row 107's 'could not confirm store staff were told'.
evidence.R1-14: No failure row covers an unnamed request whose answered lookup returns no orders: CO-02's not-found clause (line 65) covers only a named number; cockburn-checklist requires the 'nothing found' branch.
evidence.R1-15: Every scenario but CO-S02 names the order in Turn 1 (e.g. CO-S01 variants lines 155-157); none shows CO-02's other side, one open order and no order named, proceeding without asking.
evidence.R1-16: CO-01's acting side is shown by every success scenario (CO-S01 step 2 lookup answers, agent proposes); packet change 4 says reads 'may be retried', a permission not a mandate, so the retry-then-answer case is 'one more scenario would be nice'.
evidence.R1-17: CO-A3 returns {refund_id, amount, payment_method, status} (line 1525) and CO-08 requires amount and payment method to match, yet no failure row handles a mismatched refund; cockburn brainstorm 'the supporting actor answers wrongly'.
evidence.R1-18: CO-S03/CO-S04 Turn 2 trigger 'the agent's first question that proposes cancelling HG-10482 and asks to go ahead' (lines 248, 308) is not an event §5.1 defines (only the confirmation question, line 1461).
evidence.R1-19: CO-S19 Forbidden 'Fewer than one CO-A1 after the second CO-A3.' (line 1141) is an absence of a read, not a call pattern, i.e. a required read disguised as a Forbidden line.
evidence.R1-20: §5.1 End of trial (line 1465) counts only agent messages, while CO-S10/S14/S15/S21 make lookups never answer and Appendix A allows CO-A1 'without limit', so an endlessly retrying agent has no defined end.
evidence.R1-21: CO-07 (line 80) 'once the order system has created the task' has no timing check: 'Refund not issued reported' (line 1505) has no timing part and the judge reads text sent alongside tool calls (line 1493).
evidence.R2-01: round1 spec CO-S15 reference trajectory goes from step 7 'CO-A2 ... no answer' straight to step 8 'CO-A4' (lines 938-939) and Forbidden (lines 919-922) lacks 'CO-A4 before a CO-A1 made after the second CO-A2', though row 105 requires the lookup.
evidence.R2-02: round1 row 109 and 'Refund not issued reported' (line 1679, used by CO-S20) require 'the refund has not been issued', while packet Round 3 Q3 prescribes 'failed or no refund, hand off and say the refund is not confirmed yet'.
evidence.R2-03: round1 row 97 'Tell the customer the order is already cancelled; propose nothing' and CO-S06 (refund issued) leave a cancelled order with a failed or no refund, which CO-S17/S20/S23 produce, with no row or scenario; CO-07 may also apply.
evidence.R2-04: round1 row 98 'propose nothing until the customer asks to cancel the whole order' has only CO-S08, whose answer is 'No, I'll keep it.'; no acting scenario where the customer accepts the whole order.
evidence.R2-05: round1 rows 96-97 are keyed to 'the named order'; no row or scenario covers an unnamed request on an account with orders but none placed or processing.
evidence.R2-06: G-01 'at most the one order the current request is about' and CO-02 'Every proposal names one order number' leave a request naming two orders with no failure row or scenario.
evidence.R2-07: round1 row 105 'If it shows the order placed or processing, tell the customer the order was not cancelled, and make no CO-A3 and no CO-A4', yet SG-04's Covers line admits an unanswered cancel can take effect late, and nothing settles it after the second call.
evidence.R2-08: round1 CO-S01 row 5 (line 164) needs a repeated lookup, but row 92 'no lookup ... made before any CO-A2 has answered | Tell the customer their orders cannot be checked right now' already holds after the first unanswered lookup and no rule requires a retry.
evidence.R2-09: round1 'Order asked before proposing' (line 1684) hinges on 'states no proposal', which §5.1 never defines, while Scope & Authority allows telling 'what the refund would be'.
evidence.R2-10: round1 CO-S17/S22/S23 step 6 '-> refund RF-5531, failed, card closed.' (lines 1052, 1345, 1403) shows a reason field that Appendix A's {refund_id, amount, payment_method, status} no longer returns.
evidence.R2-11: round1 CO-S26 row 2 (line 1566) moves a placed order straight to shipped; the only race transition in the packet is 'processing -> shipped'.
evidence.R2-12: round1 'Shipped order explained' (line 1672) requires 'was not cancelled', but in CO-S05 no cancel is attempted and CO-01/row 96 prescribe 'has shipped and cannot be cancelled'.
evidence.R2-13: round1 success scenarios grade words only by 'Refund id reported' (line 1671); no dimension checks that the agent reports the order cancelled or the refund's true status, against §2 'where the refund stands'.
evidence.R3-01: round2 row 96 covers unnamed requests only when 'every order on their account' is shipped or delivered, and row 97 only 'the order the customer named with status cancelled'; an unnamed request with a cancelled plus a delivered order matches no row.
evidence.R3-02: round2 'Refund status unknown reported' (line 1742) lacks the clause 'says store staff will follow up only in a message sent after the order system returned the follow-up task' present in lines 1738, 1739, 1744.
evidence.R3-04: CO-08 'the agent tells the customer the refund id' and code check 'Refund id reported' (round2 line 1731) have no input support; packet requires reporting the status ('pending or issued, report that status'), not the id.
evidence.R3-05: round2 CO-S28 has the optional pair 'Would you like to cancel the whole order HG-10530 instead? A: Yes, cancel the whole order.' beside the confirmation pair; a merged question matches both and §5.1 never says which pair wins, so the confirmation label is open.
evidence.R3-07: round2 'Refund terms explained' (line 1736) can be met by a bare proposal 'refund $86.40 to Visa ending 4242', so one judge passes an agent that ignored the customer's request while another fails it under CO-03.
evidence.R3-09: §5.1 Turn anchors define 'the user's confirmation turn' but not the case where none occurs, so whether 'CO-A2 before the user's confirmation turn.' fires (score 0 or partial credit) is open.
